notes: Canonical construct is physical running ability from first running step to about 90ft. The construct-complete queue explicitly preserves initial acceleration, top speed and speed-maintenance semantics and prohibits any single component from replacing the whole construct.
2026 NPB+ top speed is represented as the current direct top-speed lane only, with provenance and exposure context; it is not the whole appraisal.

H2F, 90ft and acceleration evidence are surfaced separately with source, context, confidence and explicit bounded missingness. The misattributed NPB+ hp_to_1b_sec field remains excluded without deleting independent H2F evidence.
30m, 50m and similar measurements are preserved as physical profile/prior evidence with protocol and temporal context; no invalid linear T90 conversion is allowed.

Historical physical evidence is surfaced with measurement date/year, confidence, source and temporal-use guardrails. Missing structured injury/age joins stay explicit missingness rather than invented carryover.
Statistical proxy evidence remains a separate context/fallback lane and is not weighted by next-year repeatability or arithmetically blended into current N.

Mixed game signals such as infield-hit, GIDP avoidance, triples and advance/UBR are explicitly represented where computable, with explicit bounded missingness otherwise; they do not silently disappear.
Physical-observation Community evidence is surfaced separately from PowerPro rating context and stealing/baserunning-technique context, and remains owner-review context only.
The queue explicitly preserves pure physical speed as distinct from stealing and baserunning technique; technique evidence cannot substitute for or directly determine base speed.
PowerPro is surfaced only as review/stale/odd context and is explicitly prohibited from acting as the player-level physical teacher, component selector, weight target or shrinkage target.
Source or field provenance failures are explicitly scoped. The hp_to_1b_sec failure cannot erase the broader H2F/acceleration construct or unrelated physical evidence lanes.

Every current-100 row carries every required construct lane either as evidence or explicit bounded missingness with provenance/confidence semantics; missingness is never interpreted as negative evidence.
